canonical_name: Rice's theorem for extensional properties of unary partial-recursive programs
source_record_claim: Every nontrivial property of program behavior is undecidable (repository wording: 程序性质的非平凡性不可判定).
canonical_statement: Fix the standard enumeration phi_e of unary partial-recursive functions from natural numbers to natural numbers. For every set S of such partial functions that is extensional and nontrivial, the index set {e | phi_e belongs to S} is not computable.
domain_and_universes: Provisional Lean universe 0: Nat.Partrec.Code as program indices; unary partial functions Nat ->. Nat; an extensional property S : (Nat ->. Nat) -> Prop; computability of the induced predicate on codes.
quantifiers: an extensionality condition identifying programs with equal partial functions
witness partial functions f_in and f_out with S f_in and not S f_out
hypotheses: S depends only on the computed partial function, not the syntax or code number
S is nontrivial: it holds of at least one unary partial-recursive function and fails for at least one
programs are drawn from a fixed acceptable/effective enumeration of unary partial-recursive functions
conclusion: The predicate on program codes e given by S (Nat.Partrec.Code.eval e) is not computable.

alternate_encodings.target: Rice's original theorem for recursively enumerable sets: every nontrivial index class is recursive only if it is the empty or universal class
alternate_encodings.relationship: equivalent after selecting the accepted numbering and identifying a unary partial function with its graph/range presentation; the transport is not yet checked

alternate_encodings.target: semantic properties of recognized languages of Turing machines
alternate_encodings.relationship: standard corollary through a checked equivalence between the selected machine semantics and partial-recursive codes; not interchangeable without that bridge

alternate_encodings.target: Rice-Shapiro theorem for semidecidable extensional properties
alternate_encodings.relationship: strictly stronger refinement with additional topological/finiteness content; excluded as a substitute

excluded_degenerate_cases: The empty and universal semantic properties are excluded by nontriviality and are decidable. Syntactic properties of code text, resource bounds, promise problems, and properties that are not invariant under equality of computed partial functions are outside the root. The theorem does not assert that every question mentioning a program is undecidable.
